CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  August 26, 2025

The audio recording of the meeting is available here: DRB Meeting – August 26, 2025 (Audio)

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:00 P.M. in Conference Room A of Alhambra City Hall.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Nora Hernandez, Chairman; Michael Daninger; Stanley Tsai; Jennifer Ng

  Absent:  Vice Chairman Ankit Udani

  Staff Present: Steve Kuchenski, Secretary/City Architect; Eric Martinez, City Architect
  Representative

C.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – August 12, 2025
  • Request: This is a request for the Design Review Board to approve
  the Minutes of the August 12, 2025, Regular Meeting of the Design
  Review Board.
  • Recommended Action: Design Review Board review and approve
  as submitted the Minutes of the August 12, 2025, Regular Meeting of
  the Design Review Board.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member Ng.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

D.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-033
  • 1212 South Eighth Street
  • Applicant: Tina Bell

  1
  08/26/2025
   •  Request: This is an application for a new wall sign on an existing 1-
  story church building known as ‘The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-
  Day Saints.’
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-071
  • 824 West Ramona Road
  • Applicant: Arun Desikan & Jiyeon Kim
  • Request: This is an application for new side and rear yard gate and
  fence on an existing 1-story single-family residence.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE. The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. Provide a note on the plans stating that the replacement fence
  must match the proposed fence elevation design, with all
  horizontal supports oriented toward the interior of the
  property.
  2. Revise conflicting notes on the site plan to clearly differentiate
  between existing elements to be removed and proposed.
  •  Moved by Board Member Ng, Seconded by Board Member Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-052
  • 1209 Violeta Drive
  • Applicant: Emory Zhang & Sophia Shoa
  2
  08/26/2025
   •  Request: This is an application for a new 733 SF 1-story addition to
  the rear of an existing 1,385 SF 1-story single-family residence.
  •  Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application without conditions.
  •  Moved by Board Member Daninger, Seconded by Board Member
  Tsai.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA
ITEM 5:  DESIGN REVIEW BOARD DRB-25-001
  • 1418 South Primrose Avenue
  • Applicant: Johnson Chow
  • Request: This is an application for a new 361 SF 1-story addition to
  the front of an existing 758 SF 1-story single-family residence and
  front porch re-design. This project was continued at the DRB Meeting
  on July 22, 2025.
  • Recommended Action: APPROVE - The proposed project is
  approved without conditions.

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve the application with the following Conditions of
  Approval:
  1. The proposed addition height should maintain the existing
  overall building height.
  •  Moved by Board Member Tsai, Seconded by Board Member
  Daninger.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 4-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Hernandez, Daninger, Tsai, Ng
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Udani

AGENDA

  • 1620 Grand View Drive
  • Applicant: Kaylee Kent
  • Request: This is an application for a new 821 SF 1-story addition, a
  new 381 SF deck at the rear, and exterior remodel to an existing
